<div class="eyebrow">PhD student in physics · Virginia Tech</div>

::: {.hero-intro}
I work on quantum information, quantum foundations, and how classical structure can emerge from quantum systems.
:::

I am a second-year PhD student in ChunJun Cao's group at Virginia Tech. My current interests include operator algebra quantum error correction, quantum Darwinism and objectivity, quantum mereology, quantum gravity, and quantum computing.

## Current Work

I am interested in how information-theoretic ideas can make questions about emergence and objectivity more precise. Much of my recent work uses quantum error correction as a language for identifying when many observers, subsystems, or choices of degrees of freedom agree on a stable classical description.

[Research directions](research.qmd)
:::

::: {.section-card}
## Recent Papers

My latest preprints are on wave packets from spectra and objectivity from operator algebra quantum error correction. The publications page links out to arXiv rather than hosting PDF viewers here.

[Publications](publications.qmd)
